name: Swiggy
intro: Order food, groceries and essentials delivered in minutes. New users who sign up through our referral link can claim the current welcome offer by completing the steps below.
steps: Tap the Download button above to open the official Swiggy page.
Install Swiggy and sign up with your mobile number.
Enter the referral code if asked, and complete KYC.
Complete the qualifying action shown in the app to unlock your reward.

sections.title: Why use Swiggy?
sections.body:
- Official app on Google Play and the App Store
- Food & grocery delivery
- Trusted by millions of users in India

terms: Offer valid for new users only.
Reward amount and eligibility are decided by Swiggy and may change without notice.
Check the latest terms inside the app before signing up.

faqs.question: Who can claim the Swiggy referral bonus?
faqs.answer: New users who sign up through a referral link and complete the qualifying step shown in the app.

faqs.question: How long does the reward take?
faqs.answer: Most rewards are credited within a few days of completing the qualifying step.
